title: Choose Xbox pad art
question: Broadcast Booth Glass. Your Xbox Series ref drives silhouette and layout — blue background and glow ignored, body opaque. DualShock keeps its own PNG. Orange = live press.

options.label: Twin
options.thesis: Same language as gamepad-ds4.png: opaque charcoal fill, grey hairlines, DS4-style LT/RT tombstones, thin LB/RB bars.
options.viewport: Wide widget, no plaque. Asymmetric Xbox layout from your ref. A live, left stick out, RT squeezed. Triggers sit on the horns.
options.risk: Tombstone boxes can feel stacked if the horns read cleaner merged.

options.label: Merge
options.thesis: Horns are part of one connected outline — no separate trigger rectangles. LT/RT labels live inside the horns.
options.viewport: Same layout. Cleaner shoulders — the ref horns become the body edge, not boxes on top. Bumpers stay thin bars on the shelf.
options.risk: Analog trigger fill needs UVs inside the horn cutout.

options.label: Plateau
options.thesis: Dark top band like your ref’s black center plate — guide, view, and menu sit on it. Horns and bumpers at ref positions.
options.viewport: Same Xbox layout. The center reads closer to your photo: dark crown for Xbox / view / menu, charcoal grips below.
options.risk: Two body tones must stay subtle or the pad stops feeling like one glass family.
